data.name: American BioChar Company
data.description: American BioChar Company is a Michigan-based biochar soil amendment blender and reseller. They do not produce biochar themselves; they source NAKED Char from a producer using Southern Yellow Pine feedstock and fast pyrolysis, then blend it with humate to create VITAL Blend granular and liquid (5-micron) soil amendments sold to growers, arborists, landscapers, golf course managers, and home gardeners. Products are OMRI Listed, IBI Certified, and USDA BioPreferred.
